excluded_preflight_sessions.scope: Three synthetic pilot conditions plus one forced diagnose MCP smoke, before frozen measured campaign; never included in published measured averages.

quality: Top-5 reference path hit, file recall and valid narrow pre-fix reference-region overlap are location proxies. All 90 explanations also receive AI-assisted source-based qualitative review with conditions hidden. No external project tests or repairs validated.
preservation: Every started measured session retained, no selective reruns; missing counters null. Sources and private gold are OS-protected and fingerprinted.
limitations: One session per condition/case; descriptive paired observations, no significance claim.
Public data can overlap model training.
Production source projections omit separate tests/docs and dependencies.
Shared filesystem/provider caches and uncontrolled background activity.
Reported cost includes auxiliary model use and is not a billing invoice.
